generation.explanation: Imagine 1000 people. 10 are sick, and the test catches 9 of them. Of the 990 healthy people, 10% (99) wrongly test positive. So among 108 positive results, only 9 are truly sick, which is 9/108 ≈ 8.3%. The disease is so rare that false positives from the healthy majority swamp the true positives. Use the sliders to change prevalence and accuracy.
